items.raw_excerpt: 过去，用户和 AI 的交互更多是输入文字、上传图片，然后等待回答。现在，家长希望可以直接把镜头对准孩子正在做的题目，让 AI 一步步讲解；在穿搭建议、视障人群视频导航等场景里，用户也希望 AI 不再是一问一答，而是在整个任务过程中持续倾听、对话。

title_i18n.zh: 豆包视频通话背后，火山引擎重构 Agent 时代多模态传输底座
title_i18n.en: Behind Doubao's video calls, Volcano Engine is reshaping the multimodal transmission foundation of the Agent era.
title_i18n.es: Detrás de la videollamada de Doubao, Volcano Engine reconstruye la base de transmisión multimodal en la era de los agentes.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 过去，用户和 AI 的交互更多是输入文字、上传图片，然后等待回答。现在，家长希望可以直接把镜头对准孩子正在做的题目，让 AI 一步步讲解；在穿搭建议、视障人群视频导航等场景里，用户也希望 AI 不再是一问一答，而是在整个任务过程中持续倾听、对话。
excerpt_i18n.en: In the past, user interaction with AI mostly involved entering text, uploading images, and then waiting for a response. Now, parents hope to point the camera directly at the questions their children are working on and have the AI explain step by step. In scenarios such as outfit advice and video navigation for visually impaired people, users also want AI to no longer just ask and answer but to continuously listen and converse throughout the entire task.
excerpt_i18n.es: Antes, la interacción entre usuarios y la IA consistía principalmente en introducir texto, subir imágenes y esperar una respuesta. Ahora, los padres esperan poder enfocar la cámara directamente hacia los problemas que el niño está resolviendo para que la IA los explique paso a paso; en escenarios como sugerencias de vestimenta o navegación mediante video para personas con discapacidad visual, los usuarios también desean que la IA no se limite a preguntas y respuestas, sino que escuche y dialogue de manera continua durante toda la tarea.

Faced with changes driven by the rapid development of large models, Kingsoft Office CEO Zhang Qingyuan has been pondering these two questions. This is not just a concern for Kingsoft Office, but a new proposition for the entire office software industry. Over the past two years, large models have iterated rapidly—writing copy, making PPTs, generating tables—and more capabilities that once belonged to office software are being taken over by a chat window. "Will Office disappear?" has become a recurring topic in the industry. But Zhang Qingyuan disagrees with the judgment that "software will be replaced by AI." In his view, large models are becoming smarter, but they "only understand the world, not you." In the future, large models will provide intelligence, while software will provide "context." The two are not substitutes but will coexist long-term. In particular, current models fail to infer shared concepts from sets of example images and apply them to new inputs. We introduce Visual Concept Inference from Sets (VICIS), a task that evaluates this capability. Given a small context set of images sharing a concept and a query image, the model must generate new images that preserve the context-defined concept while remaining consistent with the query. We show that state-of-the-art VLMs perform poorly on this task…

items.raw_excerpt: The company endorsed landmark AI transparency laws in California and New York last year, but its head of US state and local policy says they may already be outdated.

title_i18n.en: Here’s Why Anthropic Is Pushing States to Regulate AI Faster
title_i18n.zh: 这就是为什么Anthropic正在推动各州更快地监管人工智能
title_i18n.es: He aquí por qué Anthropic está presionando a los estados para que regulen la IA más rápido.

excerpt_i18n.en: The company endorsed landmark AI transparency laws in California and New York last year, but its head of US state and local policy says they may already be outdated.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 去年，该公司支持了加利福尼亚州和纽约州具有里程碑意义的人工智能透明度法律，但该公司美国州及地方政策负责人表示，这些法律可能已经过时。
excerpt_i18n.es: La empresa respaldó leyes emblemáticas de transparencia de IA en California y Nueva York el año pasado, pero su responsable de políticas estatales y locales de EE. UU. dice que ya pueden estar desfasadas.
